case_number: 2025 INSC 407; CIVIL APPEAL NO. OF 2025 (Arising out of Special Leave Petition (Civil) No.32689 of 2018)
summary: Multiple civil appeals arising from SLPs concerning service and disciplinary matters; challenge to High Court's interference in departmental proceedings; scope of judicial review in service disputes; standard of proof in departmental inquiries; penalty of dismissal upheld; High Court's reappreciation of evidence in intra-court appeal held improper.
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; impugned judgment of High Court set aside; departmental penalty of dismissal restored.
